context.content_translation:
客户对手机的成本表示不满，但用户界面方面的投诉相对而言是-------的。
A. 最稀有的
B. 稀有的
C. 稀有性
D. 很少地

items.question: Customers expressed dissatisfaction with the cost of the phone, but complaints about the user interface were relatively -------.
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：将“rare”代入题干后为“Customers expressed dissatisfaction with the cost of the phone, but complaints about the user interface were relatively rare.”。选择理由：该项的词性或动词形态符合句法位置，同时与上下文语义搭配自然。正确答案：B（rare）。
